WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_BEACH: Take a trip back to the '60s and hang ten on the ocean waves! Tides are changing and those gnarly zombies make it not-so-safe to go back in the water!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_CARNIVAL: Step right up in the 1930s as a mysterious carnival invites you over for non-stop fun and excitement! Watch in awe and despair as toys and cards indulge you in their malicious trickery! Witness that and more in the big top's greatest show yet!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_COWBOY: Head down the dusty trail for a showdown with the outlaw zombies of yesteryear! Gather up your plants for the big Brain Rush of 1850!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_DARK: Bring out your undead to the year 948! Harvest mushrooms in the dark of knight and get medieval on zombies from the days of yore!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_DINO: The ground thunders under the awful feet of terrible lizards! Dinosaurs prowl the past, provoking prehistoric zombies into a frenzy of ancient antipathy!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_EGYPT: Zombies infest one of Earth's earliest civilizations! Tackle mummified monsters and more under the scorching sun of Egypt, circa 2500 BC!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_EIGHTIES: Stock up on hairspray and rewind to the 1980s! With synthesized music and voraciously radical zombies, this heinous dance party will, like, totally tax you to the MAX!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_FAIRYTALE: Solve the mysteries of this fantastical storybook infested with zombies! Can you find your way through the fog of Fairytale Forest?
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_FUTURE: In the year 2323, the zombies will have brain extraction down to a science! Can the plants of the future save you from the undead of tomorrow?
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_HOLIDAY: Take a trip back to the present and relive those special moments during special occasions. Go up against many holiday themed zombies - some familiar faces and others newcomers!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_HOLLOWS: Time has taken its toll on the Frostbite Caves. As the ice age worsens, the zombies left behind have adapted to the climate, and have sought out new leadership in the absence of Dr. Zomboss. Find out who is leading them, and help them save their tribe!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_ICEAGE: Explore the frozen wastes of prehistory and chill out with the coolest zombies ever. Beware the winds or your plants will be frozen veggies.
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_LOSTCITY: Discover the vanished city of gold, where sun is plentiful and misplaced zombies abound! Use special tiles for extra sun, for these treasure-seekers are no idol threat!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_MODERN: The end is the beginning! Return to moments before you left in a contemporary contest stocked with zombies of every egregious era!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_PIRATE: The year is 1679, the golden age of zombie piracy! Keep your booty close and your plants closer as zombies take to the seas to plunder your brains!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_SKYCITY: In this vast, endless cloudscape, a new zombie militia has risen. They've laid seige to your flying fortress, and under the command of their leader, warped this era with knowledge of the future! Protect your airship, and put an end to this paradox before something goes terribly wrong!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_STEAM: In the times of the greatest industrial advancement of the late 19th century, the zombies are hard at work. Filled with machinery and sewer holes, your plants will have a tough time defending your brains from both directions!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_TRAVELLOG: Prepare a refuel and take a detour down to Travel Log's Tourist Trap! Relive past levels from the Travel Log itself at your leisure anytime, anywhere, at any place!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_TRAVELLOG_MARK: Travel not through time, but through worlds to the Lunar Rainbow Market! Save this mysterious realm while facing fancy zombies and strange cards alike, and whatever you do, don't lose faith!

XSHOT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}Sometimes Rotobaga hears the other plants gossiping about each other. "Did you notice that so-and-so has been putting on weight?" they might say. Or, "I hear that so-and-so is dating so-and-so. Can you believe it?"  But Rotobaga isn’t the kind of plant to engage in idle gossip. She’s not interested in talking about anyone behind their leaves. She does her best to just rise above it.
XSHOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Rotobagas shoot projectiles along the four diagonals, in each direction that has a target.
XSHOT_PLANTFOOD: Fires a rapid stream of shots in all four diagonal directions.
XSHOT_TOOLTIP: Shoots along the diagonals, up to four directions at a time
YETI_FUE_DIALOG_DESCRIPTION: When a yeti appears on the map, go after him quickly! If you can spot and defeat him in the level, he'll drop fabulous prizes!
ZENGARDEN_USE_BOOST_BODY: Gets instant Plant Food effect when planted on the lawn.
ZEN_GARDEN_BEE_TUTORIAL_USE_BEE: Tap a plant. The bee will speed it up!
ZEN_GARDEN_BUY_SLOT_DIALOG_BODY: Opens up another pot to plant sprouts and earn sweet loot and boosts!
ZEN_GARDEN_DESTROY_BOOST_DIALOG_BODY: Are you sure you want to shovel this plant?  It will lose its boost.
ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_COLLECT_COINS: Here's some coins while you work towards a boost!
ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_RETURN_REMINDE: Return to Zen Garden often to boost your plants!
ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_USE_BOOST: Sunflower is now boosted! The boost lasts for one level.
ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_WATER_PLANT_FO: She's ready for water. Keep her growing to get a boost!
It's a Sunflower! She's thirsty for water.
ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_COLLECT_COI: Marigold's growing up! And she has coins for you.
A batch of coins and she's done!
ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_PLACE_SPROU: You may plant another sprout now!
ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_RETURN_REMI: Return to Zen Garden often to earn coins!
ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_WATER_PLANT: It's a Marigold! She needs water.
The Marigold is ready for water.
ZEN_GARDEN_MULTIPLANT_TEXT: You may plant multiple sprouts to add a bonus to your chance to get an uncommon or rare plant.
ZEN_GARDEN_UNLOCK_PROMPT_DESCRIPTION: Complete Ancient Egypt Day 14 to unlock Zen Garden
ZEN_GARDEN_WORTH_NO_SPROUTS: The bee will take your plant, but it hasn't grown enough to be worth any sprouts.  Sell anyway?
ZNAKELILY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}transforms zombies into stronger zomboids depending on their health
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}transforms specific zombies into special zomboids

{FLAVOR}As the zombies amassed their army within the timeline, Znake Lily merely gave a sly, slithery smile. Zomboid seeds in hand (err... tail?), he recalled his ancestor's saying hissed down through generations:

"When in Rome, do as the Romans do."
ZNAKELILY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Znake Lily transforms zombies into helpful zomboids.
ZOMBIE_BARRELROLLER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (barrel) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with barrel
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}imps thrown from barrel when destroyed

{FLAVOR}Barrel Roller Zombie is part of a super underground secret awesome club. You probably haven't heard of it. Also, his left arm is slightly longer than his right arm.
ZOMBIE_BARRELROLLER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His rolling barrel crushes plants and provides excellent protection.
ZOMBIE_BARRELROLLER_EXPLOSIVE_ALMANAC_DE:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (barrel) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with barrel
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}barrel explodes when destroyed
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to freeze effects
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}fire attacks do 20% more damage to the barrel

{FLAVOR}Powder Keg Roller was just your ordinary Barrel Roller Zombie, until his barrel rolled off into the great sea. In a desperate search to find a new one, he found a ragtag group of pirates offering homemade barrels. Unfortunately for him, they weren't homemade barrels, they were made in a factory... a BOMB factory... they're BOMBS.
His rolling barrel explodes when destroyed, and provides excellent protection.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Go to the beach, they said. Put a cone on your head, they said. So, yeah, that's what Pompadour Conehead did. He's at his best when following simple instructions.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His starfish cone gives him twice the toughness of a normal pompadour zombie.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Pompadour Buckethead tried to learn to play the ukulele. He figured it would be easier to learn than the guitar on account of how small it is. But his stiff fingers ... they just weren't made for it. Now he just bangs on his bucket. And he's not half-bad either.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His scallop shelled bucket gives him great resistance to damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (conch) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Being constantly called "egghead" in high school drove him to have a more "radical" and "hang 10" personality, but he recently decided to take the name back. Yeah, he’s an egg, and he has a shell. It may not be the right shell, but he’s owning it, isn’t he?
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His seashell head protection mechanism protects him greatly from damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Pompadour Zombie recently noticed that he was wearing only one flip-flop. He THINKS he lost the other one while doing the limbo at a bonfire party the other night. But to be honest, that entire night is a little hazy ... and that flip-flop could be anywhere.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}Go back to the beach, they said. Bring a ducky tube, they said. So, yeah, that's what Pompadour Conehead Ducky Tube did. He's still at his best when following simple instructions.
His starfish cone still gives him twice the toughness of regular pompadour ducky tubers.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}Previously considered a critically endangered species by thanatologists across the globe, recent conservation efforts to preserve the humble Pompadour Buckethead Ducky Tuber have proven to be more than fruitful. Only downside being is that they've almost entirely outcompeted and devastated the local ecosystem of Big Wave Beach, casualties include the rare Eastern Dragon Seahorse population and multiple coral formations. A bucket makes all the difference.
His scallop-shelled bucket and ducky tube combo give him great resistance to damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (conch) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}The highly stylish shell on his head is subtly undermined by the implication that his swimming capabilities are reduced to a children's toy.
His fashion statement of a shell greatly protects him from damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}It caught on.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: With the use of his totally tubular duck floatation apparatus, the Pompadour Ducky Tube Zombie can quickly waddle his way through water.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}See that starfish on Bikini Conehead's cone? She put that there herself. She gets a lot of compliments on it too. And sure enough, now it seems like everyone is accessorizing with starfish. She's a trendsetter, that one.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Her starfish cone makes her twice as tough as a basic bikini zombie.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Bikini Buckethead had big ambitions. She wanted to do more than just lurch around on a beach all day. Her life's dream: to perform internationally with a synchronized swimming team. Sadly, the nose plug was her undoing. If she only had a nose ...
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Her scallop shelled bucket provides great protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (conch) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Some dudes and dudettes think that her shell belonged to something before. Others think that her shell is a rare sea slug, residing on her head. There are few who think that SHE might be the sea slug, but hey, we’ll never really know.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Her seashell, although definitely not the hottest fashion, protects her greatly from damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Is it weird that we haven't seen any female zombies before? Some say yes. Some say no. Either way, Bikini Zombie is used to breaking new ground. She's not afraid to go where no woman zombie has gone before. You could call her a pioneer. You could call her a hero.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR1_DESCRI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}The rubber ducky makes for a nice companion during long nights floating the sea aimlessly.
Her starfish cone and ducky tube combo gives her twice the toughness and style of regular bikini ducky tubers.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR2_DESCRI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}She stubbed her toe on a rock once.
Her scallop-shelled bucket and ducky tube combo give her great resistance to damage and provides extra style.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR4_DESCRI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (conch) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}Her shell actually houses one of the great divine sages of a time long past. Mr. Grand Fizzleworth, the snail overlord of universal travel, lives in her shell and frequently tells her stories of intergalactic travel. She keeps trying to alert zombie kind of the threats of intergalactic traveller warriors and their eventual plan to destroy the earth in order to build a planetary parking lot in its place. Mr. Grand Fizzleworth chose her as the messanger, and she must respect that decision. Zombie experts however, have claimed that the shell contains nothing but her head. But she knows better.
Her seashell and ducky tube combo, while being the latest fashion trend, also protects her greatly from damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}Ever the pioneer, Bikini Ducky Tube Zombie was quick to become the first woman zombie to jump aboard the recent ducky tube hype train. It's not really all it's cracked up to be, but don't tell that reporter lady that she said that. The fallout would ruin her reputation.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION_H: With the use of her gnarly duck floatation apparatus, the Bikini Ducky Tube Zombie can quickly waddle her way through water.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FISHERMAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1000
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}pulls plants to the right
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plants next to him are tossed off the lawn

{FLAVOR}Everyone is tired of Fisherman Zombie's fishing stories. He's always bragging about the size of his catch. Time and time again, he claims to have caught "the big one." But the fact of the matter is, no one has seen him actually catch a fish. Not once. It's more than a little suspicious.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FISHERMAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Casts his line to pull far plants to him.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Talk about a disgruntled zombie. Beach Flag Zombie is fed up. None of the other zombies seem to appreciate just how difficult it is for him to swim while holding a flag. Not once have they thanked him for doing the hard work that needs to be done. So it shouldn't come as a surprise: He's been interviewing for jobs elsewhere.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge wet "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}The only thing other than brainz motivating him to move faster is the Imp Mermaid who has been obsessively chasing him around in the water trying to eat his toenails.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HE: Marks the arrival of a tidal wave of zombies.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARBAGE_NORMAL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}800
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22 (on water)

{FLAVOR}If you see these appearing on the shoreline, call an official zombie emergency number and report the sighting so that you can be immediately told that nobody cares and that you shouldn't either. An enviromentalist Dr. Zomboss is not.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARBAGE_NORMAL_DESCRIPTION_: Heaps of trash that follows the tide up to shore.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARBAGE_STRONG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16 (on water)

{FLAVOR}These ancient monuments have arrived overseas from an island long lost to the ages, and are theorized to be depicting a mythical figure. Whatever could this mean?
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARBAGE_STRONG_DESCRIPTION_: Highly durable statues that erode downstream until it hits land.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARBAGE_WEAK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}500
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4 (on water)

{FLAVOR}Before the zombies decided on ducks, they originally had these seahorse floatation devices. They were eventually thrown to waste, but now they're back with vengence... with mildly aggrivated volleyballs.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARBAGE_WEAK_DESCRIPTION_HE: Stationary obstacle that flows along tide until it reaches land again.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with driftwood
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Imp Mermaid when damaged

{FLAVOR}This big guy loves the water. When he's deep down in it, he feels light as a feather. He feels like he's flying. Most importantly, during those precious moments, he feels as if the weight of Imp Mermaid Zombie has been lifted from his shoulders.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Titanic zombie who isn't shellfish with his might.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GREASER_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}500 (plastic wrap) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Everything was going great for Greaser Imp. Awesome beach party with all his buddies, interesting brains to meet and consume, but then Dr. Zomboss came outta nowhere with his weird shark thing. Next thing he knows, he's stuck at the bottom of the sea, and he's pretty sure he had some scuffle with a sea sponge? Swimming his way back up to surface was rough, being trapped in this plastic and all, but he wasn't going down without a fight. His next escapade? Dealing with that punk shark. He's sure he could take it down.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GREASER_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Washes out on land, stuck in discarded plastic. When broken free, he'll continue forward - in style.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Imp Mermaid Zombie couldn't decide whether to wear the top made out of coconut shells or the top made out of seashells. She went with the slinky coconut-shell number because, really, the seashells are soooo last wave.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Washes in past your defenses, then flounders forward.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_OCTOPUS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}910
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}bound plants are passive until their octopus (400 HP) is destroyed

{FLAVOR}It started innocently enough. One day, Octo Zombie decided to get a pet octopus. But he loved that octopus so much, he got another and another ... and another. Next thing you know, he was volunteering at an octopus rescue shelter. And now, well, no one wants to tell him, but he's pretty much the undersea equivalent of a cat lady. You should see how many are living at his house. It's quite startling.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_OCTOPUS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Throws octopi at your plants to bind them up.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SHELL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2000 (shell) + 270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12 (when in shell), 0.22 (freed)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 10 times the normal damage when in shell

{FLAVOR}Clearly this zombie hasn't broken out of their shell, but that's okay. Some shells are emotional, but others allow you to viciously snap through plants in total safety, and this zombie is okay with that.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SHELL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Wears a sturdy shell and uses it to clamp at plants it meets, heavily damaging them.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SHELL_SHIELD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3000 (shell) + 270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12 (when in shell), 0.22 (freed)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to movement impairing effects until the shell is broken

{FLAVOR}Don't even think about telling this guy that shell tongue twister. He's heard it a million times over, and is probably why he still hermits into his shell to stop hearing it.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SHELL_SHIELD_DESCRIPTION_HE: Wears a protective shell and stops at most plants it encounters.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SNORKEL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}submerges to avoid attacks

{FLAVOR}Snorkel Zombie has a hard time getting the Bikini Zombies. He's tried offering them flowers, jewelry, and even chocolate-covered brains. But nothing seems to work. They just can't seem to see past the snorkel on his face.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SNORKEL_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}800
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}cannot be targeted by most plants while submerged
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off his head

{FLAVOR}Snorkel Zombie and Scuba Zombie have fierce competition. Snorkel Zombie may be able to dodge horizontal shots, but has his skeleton withered from constant exposure to high water pressures? Scuba Zombie doesn’t think so! He also is unable to think at all!
Scuba Zombies are submerged so deep that they cannot be targeted by as many plants compared to their counterpart.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SURFER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700 (surfboard) + 350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.55 (surfing), 0.185 (on land)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}can crush a plant with his board

{FLAVOR}Surfer Zombie took up surfing just last year. At first, he only did it because he thought it would make him look cool. But he was a natural. Now he can hang 10 with the best of them. Now he's headed to the pro circuit. Now he IS cool.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SURFER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Surfs past plants on the water, then carries board on land.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_ALLSTAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16 (normal), 0.5 (tackling)
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to light knockback
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off his head

{FLAVOR}Big Head All-Star truly doesn't even know how to football. The only thing he knows is that you need to use your head, and he's got plenty of that.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_ALLSTAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: A big-headed zombie who charges your defensive line.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to light knockback

{FLAVOR}Getting that cone there was more difficult than people give him credit for.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His carefully balanced cone gives him twice the toughness of normal big head zombies.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to light knockback

{FLAVOR}The bucket just fell on his head and he rolled with it. It is statistically 2.39% more likely for you to have a bucket fall onto your head if your head is three times as big.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His ordinarily-sized bucket makes him greatly resistant to damage.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}650 (balloon) + 250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to light knockback

{FLAVOR}Big Head Balloon got his big head from his father’s side of the family. The balloon was a gift from his grandmother. And he got the birthmark in a place he’d rather not talk about from his mother’s side of the family.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Big-headed zombie with a balloon. Zombie will float above plants until balloon is popped.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to light knockback

{FLAVOR}Some legends say this zombie came to be because of a glitch in the matrix, a cheat code never meant to be dawned, a crack in reality itself. He won't say he actually just misfired Zomboss' shrink ray because all those things sound cooler.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to light knockback

{FLAVOR}He had ambitions. Getting a nice house, getting a nice job, and so on. He reached the first step, but couldn't get into the door frame. A life story of why this zombie now has to bear the flag.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge (headed) "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to light knockback
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with pole
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Big Head Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}You never truly get to appriciate how light imps are until you're stuck carrying a huge 30-pound-headed one.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HE: Enormous zombie with an even more enormous head.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to light knockback

{FLAVOR}Others may revel in their new sizes, but this zombie just wants to be able to crawl below the floorboards again.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is tossed past most of your defenses, then wobbles onward.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_LOSTPILOT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to light knockback

{FLAVOR}His latest plane went down due to the sheer weight of his ambitions. And head. Mainly head.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_NEWSPAPER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}800 (newspaper) + 460
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22 (normal), 0.88 (when angry)
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to light knockback
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage normally, 8 times the normal damage when angry

{FLAVOR}He's using his newfound big brain to finally solve the sudoku on the fifth page.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_NEWSPAPER_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Newspaper protects big-headed zombie, who is then enraged when it is destroyed.
ZOMBIE_BIGHEAD_SUPERFAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
